dct_description_sm: Relief shown pictorially.; Bar scales given in ""leucae Hispanicae"" and ""milliaria German.""; Appears in the author's Atlas ou Representation du monde Universel et des Parties. Henrici Hondij, 1633. (p. 705-780, 8Q.); Publication information from host item.; Two pages with vertical join in center.; Title, inset, and scale bars in decorative cartouches.; Illustrated with drawings of people, ships, and sea monsters.; Prime meridian:[Azores?]; Text on verso in French; L'Amerique meridionale.; Includes inset showing perspective plan, ""Cusco metropolis Peru"".; ""Medius meridianus est 320 reliqui ad hunc incurvatur ratione sphaerica.""
dct_publisher_sm: Chez Henry Hondius, demeurant sur le Dam, a l'enseigne du chien vigilant (Amsterdam)
